title: Rate limiting plan for the public API

# Rate limiting for the public API

## Goal

Keep one busy API key from slowing the API down for everyone else.

## Design

A token bucket for each API key, kept in Redis, refilled every second. A request over the limit gets `429 Too Many Requests` at once, with `Retry-After` set to the seconds until the next token.

## Limits

| Keys | Requests a minute |
|---|---|
| Customer keys | to be decided |
| Internal keys | to be decided |

## Out of scope

Limits per IP address, and a dashboard of who is throttled.
